claims.claim: Maintained CUDA-free reference and conformance cases satisfy the repository's accepted contracts for their tested scope.
claims.oracle: Repository-controlled reference implementations, schemas, and conformance checks
claims.falsifier: A maintained accepted reference/conformance case fails for the tested revision.
limitations: Does not establish physical GPU execution, production reliability, or performance.

claims.claim: The complete framework is physically qualified as a production GPU-resident search runtime.
claims.falsifier: Missing physical end-to-end qualification, incorrect results, host-driven progression where device ownership is required, or unresolved resource/runtime failures reject the claim.
limitations: Physical end-to-end CUDA qualification remains open.
